source: Hand-curated seed list maintained in this repository at internal/siteconsent/categories.json. brw does not subscribe to a commercial categorisation feed and does not fetch this list at runtime; what ships in the binary is exactly what is in this file.
update: Edit this file and open a pull request against Don-Works/brw. TestCategoryDataIsWellFormed gates the shape. Operators who need a different list on their own machines extend or replace it through the admin config's category_domains map rather than waiting on a release.
coverage: A seed list of well-known hosts per category, not an exhaustive classification of the web. An origin absent from it is NOT thereby known to be outside the category - it is only unlisted. Treat a hit as reliable and a miss as unknown.

categories.name: financial-services
categories.title: Financial services
categories.why: A mistaken action here moves money and cannot be undone by closing the tab.

categories.name: adult
categories.title: Adult content
categories.why: Not somewhere an agent should take a browser on its own initiative, and a signed-in profile makes the visit attributable to the user.

categories.name: pirated
categories.title: Pirated media and paywalled works
categories.why: Fetching from these makes the user the one who downloaded it, from their own address, on their signed-in profile.
